correctness.rationale: The classical exceptional-class list in the chosen blowup lattice identifies curves uniquely and is Frobenius-equivariant by permutation of the eight multiplicities. Independently generating the orbit of E_1 under adjacent-coordinate swaps and the quadratic Cremona reflection yields all 240 classes and total pair histogram (6720,15120,6720,120). Testing invariant pairs as fixed singletons or 2-cycles and invariant triples as 1+1+1, 1+2 or 3, and counting triangles among fixed curves by common-neighbor intersections, reproduces all 22 rows. The low-arity collision is structural: the two odd-order permutations (5,3) and (7,1) must fix each curve in a fixed pair; in both cases only a Bertini-complementary pair of intersection 3 survives. For (7,1) a triple cannot be stable, since there are only two fixed curves and no 3-cycles. In (5,3), stability of a 3-orbit requires the 5-cycle to fix its classes. In the cubic family the possible 3-orbits with the zero and double point on the moving three indices have positive pair intersections; the four skew triples come from the moving exceptional divisors, lines, and their Bertini complements. The all-types conclusion is finite exhaustion, not extrapolation. For sharp necessity even among actual surfaces over a shared field, realize both types over sufficiently large extensions F_(5^r) with r=1 mod 105: for each type the general-position open subset of the product of restrictions of scalars of P^2 from F_(5^ell) is geometrically integral and nonempty; Lang–Weil gives simultaneous realization, and the chosen residue class preserves the cycle lengths.
residual_risks: Conditional on the marked blowup in characteristic at least five; not a realization theorem for every finite field or unmarked degree-one surface. The proof counts setwise-fixed unordered flags, not intersection points or flags with an individual rationality condition.

value.rationale: An arithmetic marking invariant from one field and low-order geometry is a motivated alternative to extension-field measurements. The collision shows exactly why every intersection-labeled pair statistic can fail, and gives a concrete geometric witness for the information gained by skew triples.
residual_risks: The value is the minimal arity within the specified one-field unordered incidence test, not a claim of absolute minimality over arbitrary invariants.
